info.name: RideThroughCore
info.description:
Rack-level data center ride-through: grid -> PSU -> 48 V busbar -> servers, with BBU
   backup and staged cooling trips. Averaged (RMS) power-balance model; see
   Parameter_Table.md for every value and its provenance.

v_sense_pu.comment: Filtered Service Delivery Point voltage, for protection

der(v_sense_pu).comment: der(Filtered Service Delivery Point voltage, for protection)

i_grid_pu.comment: Grid current as a fraction of maximum normal

p_grid_w.comment: Active power drawn from the grid

p_psu_w.comment: Power the PSUs deliver to the busbar

v_sdp_pu.comment: Voltage at the Service Delivery Point

bbu_backup_s.comment: Rated backup time at module rating

PSU_TON_BBU_S.comment: Base turn-on; the sampled random delay adds to this

Z_EFF_FACTOR.comment: Fraction of |Z| that becomes real voltage drop

i_grid_pu.$pDERNLSJac1.dummyVarNLSJac1.comment: Grid current as a fraction of maximum normal

p_grid_w.$pDERNLSJac1.dummyVarNLSJac1.comment: Active power drawn from the grid

p_psu_w.$pDERNLSJac1.dummyVarNLSJac1.comment: Power the PSUs deliver to the busbar

i_grid_pu.$pDERNLSJac0.dummyVarNLSJac0.comment: Grid current as a fraction of maximum normal

p_grid_w.$pDERNLSJac0.dummyVarNLSJac0.comment: Active power drawn from the grid

p_psu_w.$pDERNLSJac0.dummyVarNLSJac0.comment: Power the PSUs deliver to the busbar

equation: 0.5 * swing_size_frac * p_it_rated_w * (if sin(6.283185307179586 * swing_freq_hz * time + swing_phase) >= 0.0 then 1.0 else -1.0)
if psu_enabled then min(p_server_w, n_psu * 3000.0 * max(v_sdp_pu, 0.0)) else 0.0
if v_sdp_pu > 0.01 then p_grid_w / (p_total_rated_w * v_sdp_pu) else 0.0
if psu_enabled then if noEvent(p_server_w < n_psu * 3000.0 * max(v_sdp_pu, 0.0)) then 0.0 else n_psu * 3000.0 * (if noEvent(v_sdp_pu > 0.0) then v_sdp_pu.SeedNLSJac0 else 0.0) else 0.0
if v_sdp_pu > 0.01 then p_total_rated_w * (p_grid_w.$pDERNLSJac0.dummyVarNLSJac0 * v_sdp_pu - p_grid_w * v_sdp_pu.SeedNLSJac0) / (p_total_rated_w * v_sdp_pu) ^ 2.0 else 0.0
if psu_enabled and e_frac > 0.625 then 1.0 else 0.0
if bbu_active and soc > 0.0 then 48.0 else 50.75 - 6.0 * (1.0 - e_frac)

(if cool_s2_tripped then 0.30000000000000004 else if cool_s1_tripped then 0.7 else 1.0) * cooling_compressor_frac + (if cool_s2_tripped and t_cool_ok < 0.25 then 0.5 else if cool_s1_tripped and t_cool_ok < 0.25 then 0.7 else 1.0) * (cooling_fan_frac + cooling_pump_frac)
if servers_lost_power then 0.0 else workload * p_it_rated_w + p_swing_w

if time >= dip_start_s and time < dip_start_s + dip_duration_s then dip_depth_pu else if second_dip and time >= dip_start_s + dip_duration_s + reclose_gap_s and time < dip_start_s + 2.0 * dip_duration_s + reclose_gap_s then dip_depth_pu else 1.0
if psu_enabled then min(p_server_w, n_psu * 3000.0 * $cse1) else 0.0
if v_sdp_pu > 0.01 then p_grid_w / (p_total_rated_w * v_sdp_pu) else 0.0
if psu_enabled then if noEvent(p_server_w < n_psu * 3000.0 * $cse1) then 0.0 else n_psu * 3000.0 * $cse1.$pDERNLSJac1.dummyVarNLSJac1 else 0.0
if v_sdp_pu > 0.01 then p_total_rated_w * (p_grid_w.$pDERNLSJac1.dummyVarNLSJac1 * v_sdp_pu - p_grid_w * v_sdp_pu.SeedNLSJac1) / (p_total_rated_w * v_sdp_pu) ^ 2.0 else 0.0
if bbu_active and soc > 0.0 then max(0.0, p_server_w - p_psu_w) else 0.0
if psu_enabled and p_psu_w >= p_server_w then max(0.0, 20.0 * (e_holdup_max_j - e_holdup_j)) else p_bbu_w - (p_server_w - p_psu_w)
